symptoms_en: Leaves turn yellow, edges curl down and redden, and in bad attacks the leaves bronze and crumble ('hopper burn'); growth is stunted.
symptoms_hi: पत्तियाँ पीली पड़ती हैं, किनारे नीचे मुड़कर लाल हो जाते हैं और ज़्यादा प्रकोप में पत्तियाँ भूरी होकर चूर हो जाती हैं ('हॉपर बर्न'); बढ़वार रुकती है।

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of bendi
symptoms_en.quote: Tender leaves become yellow The margin of the leaves start curling downwards and reddening sets in In the case of severe infestation leaves get a bronze which is typical “hopper burn” symptom

symptoms_en.title: TNAU Agritech Portal, crop protection: pests of potato
symptoms_en.quote: Tips of affected leaves become brown, turn upwards and get dried up
